review: Reviewed the full sampled time-player, raster, source-lock retry, buffer scheduling, display palette and observer-frame pose helpers. Time selection is bounded and labels requested playhead, image observation, model time, GONG candidate and unresolved slots separately. Display transitions do not establish measured intermediate fields.

One explicit Prepare range action admits bounded acquisition and optional owner retention. Source lock contention retries the same request with an abortable bounded wait; storage blocks stop ahead-of-playhead buffering and remain distinct from missing observations.

Reproduced and repaired cross-account checkpoint persistence: a profile/revision change remounts the selected playback mode and invokes its cleanup while keeping the mode choice. Same-profile policy refresh does not erase selection. Four before-fix UI regressions failed; five account-boundary checks now pass.

Reproduced and repaired retained-pair joins: an independently valid archive or receipt cannot substitute for the exact selected owner, manifest ID, archive/frame, model receipt/catalog or parent model/hash/time/map epoch. Thirteen adversarial cases failed before repair, including observable rendering of mismatched source data and source requests for mismatched checkpoints.

Source schemas and cryptographic archive replay remain unchanged. Tests construct synthetic display archives through the real serializer and replay verifier; the source FITS hash is a declaration in the browser, not authenticated science evidence.

Raster keeps its FITS-row flip and existing square-root grayscale default. Optional AIA palettes and quaternion observer poses are display-only transforms. Their inclusion does not validate model/image physical registration or acquire new source bytes.
limits: Private unfrozen source proposal. The running R380 package does not contain either new time-player repair. No public push, sign-in, model inference, source acquisition, Minecraft operation or EXE restart occurred.

SolarMagneticGlobe, SolarRobPfssBrowser and SolarDailyMoviePlayer remain separately held dependency reviews. The sampled player tests mock the globe and daily renderer; this review does not qualify actual WebGL rendering, daily movie playback or memory limits.

Shared scientific contracts/replay and public comparison JS remain canonical inputs for focused tests; omitted dependencies are explicitly listed by selected-entry compilation. This source preview is not a standalone complete platform build.

The existing raster archive test reads a separately hashed local fixture and verifies display bytes. Fixture bytes and local runtime artifacts are not exported. This is not independent source authentication or physical validation.
Client identity checks supplement existing server account and source validation; they do not grant authorization. Live account concurrency and matching installed/domain acceptance remain open.
Five inherited intentional support-contact matches remain in the final owner publication review.
